description: This PHP source file defines the BackupClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Backup service. It includes method annotations for various backup-related operations, indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods. The class extends the generic AwsClient class.

classes.name: BackupClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Backup, providing methods to manage backups, restore points, recovery plans, and related operations.

methods.name: cancelLegalHold
methods.description: Cancels a legal hold using the AWS Backup service.

methods.name: createBackupSelection
methods.description: Creates a backup selection for a backup plan.

methods.name: createLogicallyAirGappedBackupVault
methods.description: Creates a logically air-gapped backup vault.

methods.name: deleteBackupVaultAccessPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the access policy for a backup vault.

methods.name: deleteBackupVaultLockConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the lock configuration for a backup vault.

methods.name: deleteBackupVaultNotifications
methods.description: Deletes notifications for a backup vault.

methods.name: disassociateRecoveryPointFromParent
methods.description: Disassociates a recovery point from its parent.

methods.name: getBackupPlanFromJSON
methods.description: Retrieves a backup plan from JSON.

methods.name: getBackupPlanFromTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a backup plan from a template.

methods.name: getBackupVaultAccessPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the access policy of a backup vault.

methods.name: getBackupVaultNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for a backup vault.

methods.name: getRecoveryPointIndexDetails
methods.description: Gets details about recovery point index.

methods.name: getRecoveryPointRestoreMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves restore metadata for a recovery point.

methods.name: getRestoreJobMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a restore job.

methods.name: getRestoreTestingInferredMetadata
methods.description: Gets inferred metadata for restore testing.

methods.name: listBackupPlanVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of a backup plan.

methods.name: listProtectedResourcesByBackupVault
methods.description: Lists protected resources by backup vault.

methods.name: listRecoveryPointsByBackupVault
methods.description: Lists recovery points by backup vault.

methods.name: listRecoveryPointsByLegalHold
methods.description: Lists recovery points by legal hold.

methods.name: listRestoreJobsByProtectedResource
methods.description: Lists restore jobs by protected resource.

methods.name: putBackupVaultAccessPolicy
methods.description: Sets the access policy for a backup vault.

methods.name: putBackupVaultLockConfiguration
methods.description: Sets lock configuration for a backup vault.

methods.name: putBackupVaultNotifications
methods.description: Sets notifications for a backup vault.
